scenes.setting_guess: the past; a lookout/bridge where the couple argue
scenes.summary: Celia called Thom a jerk as he explained he wanted to go to space while she stayed with her robotics. Pressed, Thom admitted he was freaked out by her robot hand, and Celia ended the relationship. A voice announced that a robot's memory had been synced and locked.

beats.text: Thom breaks up with Celia to chase his dream of going to space while she stays with her robotics
Thom admits the real reason: he is freaked out by Celia's robot hand and has nightmares about robotic claws
Celia ends it: 'Whatever, Thom. We're done.'
A robot's memory is synced and locked at that moment of the breakup

humor.joke: Thom confesses nightmares about 'giant robotic claws of death'

quotes.why: opening line, repeated later as a callback

open_threads: Whose memory was synced, and why does it matter?

scenes.setting_guess: unclear; long gaps suggest mostly visual scenes
scenes.summary: Sparse lines over long silences: someone found something freaky, someone was asked why they were not 'down there', and someone admitted overhearing the couple the night before while another insisted it was not their fault.

beats.text: A bystander overheard the couple's fight and insists 'it's not my fault'

open_threads: What happened between the breakup and the present? (likely shown visually, not in dialogue)

scenes.setting_guess: a staging point before a military operation
scenes.summary: Thom was hyped up as a 'rockstar' before an operation. Barley estimated a ten-minute window and soldiers were ordered to move out.

beats.text: An armed team launches a time-critical operation with a window of about ten minutes
Thom, clearly nervous, is reassured he is a 'rockstar'

humor.joke: 'Of course you're ready, you're a rockstar' to an obviously unready Thom

moments.what: soldiers storm out ('Move your asses! Go go go!')

scenes.summary: As they caught sight of 'her', the director coached Thom like an actor: she is your passion, be tender, be honest, remind her what love is.

beats.text: The plan relies on Thom: he is coached to approach 'her' tenderly and remind her what love is

humor.joke: the director's over-the-top acting notes in the middle of a battle

quotes.why: states the mission in emotional terms

moments.what: director's pep talk as Thom sees her

scenes.setting_guess: a re-staged copy of the breakup location, under attack
scenes.summary: The team re-staged the original breakup as a film take while a 'memory overwrite' ran, with Thom repeating his old lines. With enemies two minutes away, Thom went off-script, admitting he was young and a jerk but that it was no reason to destroy the world. The take collapsed into 'Abort! Cut!' and screams.

beats.text: The plan revealed: they re-stage the original breakup as a film take to overwrite a memory
Enemies close in with two minutes left and Thom is told to speed up
Thom goes off-script: he was young and a jerk, but that is no reason to destroy the world, revealing Celia is the threat
The take falls apart into 'Abort! Cut!' and screaming chaos

humor.joke: a flubbed take ('Ohp- Sorry! Sorry.') during a life-or-death re-enactment

scenes.summary: Celia confronted Thom: he broke her heart and forgot her on earth, and she threatened to crush him. Thom simply said he was sorry, which the director praised as a 'good ad-lib'. Someone again insisted it was not their fault, 'this time'.

beats.text: Celia reveals her motive: Thom broke her heart and forgot her on earth; she threatens to crush him
Thom sincerely apologizes; the director calls it a 'good ad-lib'
Running gag: 'Not my fault! This time.'

humor.joke: a heartfelt apology is judged as an acting choice
'Not my fault! This time.' callback to L13

quotes.why: reveals why she turned on the world

scenes.setting_guess: the set during the final assault
scenes.summary: Out of time, the battle peaked; the overwrite reached 90% while a soldier begged the captain to abort. Thom told Celia the world had changed and maybe they could too, and the memory overwrite completed.

beats.text: Out of time, the battle peaks as the overwrite reaches 90% and soldiers beg to abort
Thom tells Celia 'The world's changed... maybe we can too' and the memory overwrite completes

moments.what: battle roar and the call to abort
Thom's final words to Celia as the overwrite completes

scenes.summary: In the aftermath someone remarked there was a lesson to learn from all this, and that it could have gone worse.

beats.text: Coda: 'There's a lesson to be learned from this... Could'a gone worse.'

story_so_far: Years ago Thom left Celia, who has a robot hand and works in robotics, to go to space, admitting her hand freaked him out; at that moment a robot's memory was synced. In the present Celia has become a world-destroying threat. A military team and a film-director-like leader re-stage the breakup as a take to overwrite her memory, with Thom as the actor. Under attack, Thom goes off-script, Celia reveals he broke her heart and forgot her on earth, Thom apologizes, and as the battle peaks he says the world has changed and maybe they can too; the overwrite completes. Someone wryly notes it could have gone worse.
